paras: Myriopholis narirostris is a species of snake in the family Leptotyphlopidae. It is found in West Africa (Ghana, Togo, Nigeria, and possibly Guinea) and in Middle Africa (Central African Republic); the Reptile Database indicates a more extensive distribution in these areas.
Myriopholis narirostris inhabit wet savanna and dry forest.
